title: dahlia crocea
intro: Dahlia crocea, commonly known as the Mexican dahlia or Golden Dahlia, is a species of flowering plant in the dahlia genus. It is valued for its golden, daisy-like flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dahlia crocea include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
